approach.title: Understand the body. Work with care.

col1.title: A personal approach
col1.text: We start with a conversation about your training load and goals. You mark the areas on the 3D model, and your specialist sees them before you arrive.

col2.title: Your comfort
col2.text: A private room, a time that suits you, and service in Russian or English.

col3.title: Results in motion
col3.sub: Exercises and a plan for home
col3.text: After your session you get exercises and a plan for home. We schedule your next visit around that plan, not out of habit.

step1.title: Assessment
step1.text: We talk through your training load, check your mobility and look at the areas you marked on the 3D model.

step2.title: Plan
step2.text: We choose the technique: massage, myofascial release, exercise therapy or a combination.

step3.title: Session
step3.text: Hands-on work in a private room.

step4.title: At home
step4.text: Exercises and guidance for home, then a follow-up visit as planned.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.more: Can’t find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp

choose.q: How do I choose a service?
choose.a: The quickest way is to mark the areas on the 3D model. We’ll match a service to them and show it first in the list, with a label. You can choose any other service: each one shows its price and duration. If you’re not sure, describe in your own words what’s bothering you, and your specialist will see your note before the visit.

duration.q: How long does a session last?
duration.a: The duration is shown on every service: in the services list, on the service page and during booking. All times are in Dubai time.
duration.todo: TODO(content): typical session length for each type of service, and how much time to allow before and after

prepare.a: Mark the areas on the 3D model in advance and briefly describe what’s bothering you: your specialist will see it before your visit.
prepare.todo: TODO(content): how to prepare: what to wear, eating and drinking beforehand, when to arrive, what to bring

specialist.a: Yes. At the “Specialist” step you can pick a particular person (each card shows a photo, name, rating and next available slot) or leave it on “Any specialist”. You’ll find more about each of them in the “Team” section.

reschedule.q: How do I reschedule a booking?
reschedule.a: Open “My bookings”: sign in with your phone number and an SMS code (no password needed), or follow the link from your booking SMS or email. Tap “Reschedule” and choose a new time.
reschedule.todo: TODO(content): the minimum notice for rescheduling and cancelling, the cancellation rules, and a WhatsApp contact for urgent cases

contraindications.a: Yes, any kind of bodywork has limits. The list of contraindications is in the left-hand panel on the booking page and on each service page, and you confirm you’ve read it before you book. If in doubt, check with your doctor.
